items.title: Amaziah the priest of Bethel
items.charge: Forbidding Amos to prophesy at the king's chapel; accusing him to Jeroboam of conspiracy

items.title: Ananias the high priest
items.charge: Commanding Paul to be smitten on the mouth, contrary to the law, while sitting to judge him by the law

items.title: Antiochus Epiphanes
items.charge: Defiling the temple; forbidding the law; murdering the faithful

items.title: Antipas, Smyrna, and Philadelphia
items.charge: Faithful unto death; keeping the word of his patience; not denying his name in the place where Satan's seat is

items.title: Apollonius
items.charge: Falling upon Jerusalem on the Sabbath under a pretence of peace; slaying a great multitude; taking women and children captive

items.title: Asa in his latter years
items.charge: Hiring the king of Syria against Israel; imprisoning the seer who reproved him; seeking to the physicians and not to the Lord

items.title: Caiaphas and the council
items.charge: Seeking false witness against Christ; condemning him by night; delivering him to the Gentiles; forbidding the apostles; stoning Stephen

items.title: Daniel's accusers
items.charge: Conspiring by law against an innocent man

items.title: Haman the Agagite
items.charge: Plotting the destruction of all the Jews; building a gallows for Mordecai

items.title: Herod Antipas and Herodias
items.charge: Taking his brother's wife; beheading John for saying so

items.title: Herod the Great and the children of Bethlehem
items.charge: Slaying all the male children of Bethlehem from two years old and under

items.title: Jehoiakim
items.charge: Building with unrighteousness; shedding innocent blood; burning the scroll of the Lord's words

items.title: Jerusalem, that killeth the prophets
items.charge: Killing the prophets and stoning them that are sent; not knowing the time of her visitation

items.title: Jezebel
items.charge: Killing the prophets of the Lord; promoting Baal; witchcrafts

items.title: Joash of Judah
items.charge: Forsaking the Lord after Jehoiada's death; stoning Zechariah in the temple court

items.title: Onesiphorus
items.charge: Oft refreshing Paul, and not ashamed of his chain; seeking him out very diligently in Rome

items.title: Pashur the son of Immer
items.charge: Smiting the prophet and putting him in the stocks; prophesying lies

items.title: Paul, at the end of his course
items.charge: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith

items.title: Saul and Doeg at Nob
items.charge: Slaughter of the priests of the Lord on an informer's report

items.title: Saul of Tarsus
items.charge: Persecuting the church; consenting to Stephen's death; compelling the saints to blaspheme

items.title: Shemaiah the Nehelamite
items.charge: Sending letters from Babylon to have Jeremiah put in prison and in the stocks; prophesying a lie

items.title: The adversaries of Judah and Benjamin
items.charge: Weakening the hands of the people; hiring counsellors against them to frustrate the building of the house of God

items.title: The scribes and Pharisees
items.charge: Shutting up the kingdom against men; devouring widows' houses; tithing mint and omitting judgment, mercy and faith; whited sepulchres

items.title: Timotheus
items.charge: Gathering the heathen to root out the Jews; a second campaign after being once spared
